photo_storage: app-private files; record relative references only; never commit customer images
multi_device: A case may include several independently identified connected devices/accessories; do not assume one USB connection implies one target.
batch_diagnostics: Create a reviewable plan per connected device; execute only supported read-only checks after permission/compatibility checks.
notifications: Local app notifications for status, approval, completion, and reconnect events; no remote portal in this phase.
reports: Aggregate counts and confirmed outcomes; keep hypotheses separate and do not expose customer identifiers by default.
camera: Request camera permission only when user taps capture; USB UVC microscope support is conditional on host hardware, Android API, driver and device compatibility.
network_policy: No IP scanning, WEP, or remote device discovery required for this local workflow.
